# Goblin candidate pack

43 separate monster designs + hero with distinct dagger/sword forms, each 9 generated poses including real collapsed death, 192x192 anchor [96,176], LEFT facing per frame. 10 unique 480x270 backgrounds; existing camp reused. 50 equipment, 30 skill and 18 material raster icons. `asset-manifest.json` paths relative dist. Source atlas row identity is unique for each monster; no hue-swap substitutes. Built-in imagegen used; native proof contact sheets inspected and row crops corrected.

21 active / 9 passive / 99 unlock points; branch26 leaves18 points at level45 for utilities. Active4/passive2/presets3/free resets metadata. Poison unchanged2%/3s/max5/shield-first/no crit/no amp. Ambush uses >75% and <30% target HP conditions, not crit. Contraptions finite action-reactive charges and hitDown/attackDown, never immunity or timer suppression.

Integrator requirements: dispatch `raceReactive` to `applyReactiveEffect(runtime,effect,clock)`; call `onEnemyAction` once after direct enemy action with runtime/event/hero/targets. Persist runtime within encounter and carry across normal dungeon3 stages. Reactive action hits have reaperEligible:false, independentCrit:false, activeCastCount:0, recursiveCounter:false. Do not feed them back into enemy-action hook. Pass full target hp/maxHp/poisonLayers; `spore_transfer` requires selected poisoned target. Material IDs retain potion recipe `goblin.mat.01–16` IDs.

Approved revised legendary reducers: per-target first-hit shield theft (40% enemy shield, cap8% hero maxHP,6s) or70%attack fallback stab withcrit/lifesteal but no recursion; enemy-miss longest equipped active cooldown rewind2rounds with6600ms combat-only ICD carried across fights. Old12%/+1500ms candidates removed. Own-race boss total5% policy central. New dagger_balanced/sword_balanced budgets central. Innate10% extra common regular material quantity hook, normalquality/source only, excludes special/story/gem/fruit/mark.

Validation: `node goblin-pack-tests.mjs` passes 63 skill plans through actual typed effect host (69 applications), canonical source eligibility, all10 recovery+gem, 43 unique sprite rows, finite reactive JSON continuation, poison cap/tick invariant. Contact sheets validate asset identity; separate native battle captures exercise actual production rendering, not browser screenshots. Actual23nodes/21skill encounters, real2/4sets, revisedlegendary proc events, retinue budget/settlement tests pass against main; native24 battle captures include both weapon lifecycles, ten regions, A09 four-target boss, A06/A07 five-target elites. A06 giant crab silhouette overlaps its followers heavily and remains a renderer review item. The 24-row capped matrix used a cached pre-shared-freeze gear snapshot; the final three-row diagnostic uses frozen shared exact gear. Lv100/A10 sword, HP6177/ATK998/armor823, zero talents/passives/sets/specials: mixed-control four-offense34 potions/1036kills, clean existing four-offense44/991, identical-gear Dwarf58/1113; all zero deaths. Balanced/sustain zero potions is legitimate, not a monster-buff target. Targeted10minute online/offline comparison matches490 turns/43kills and entire combat state after generated-ID normalization; aggregate build/release remains integrator gate. Parameters copied from current approved dwarf budget by corresponding area/rank as initial comparable candidate, not final approved balance. No deployment.

Goblin attackDown is capped to25% target.baseAtk (snapshotu.atk beforetemporaryeffects); reapplications use originalbase, generic strongest-source host aggregation avoids additive stacking.
